docker run -p 8080:8080 -d \
--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway \
-e ConnectionStrings__PostgreSQL="Host=host.docker.internal;Port=5432;Database=appForDeploy1;Username=postgres;Password=qwerty" \
-e ConnectionStrings__Redis="redishost:6379" \
--name my-app1 \
--network app-for-deploy1-network \
appfordeploy1:1.0

docker run -d -p 6379:6379 --name redishost redis:latest

Inside the application container, localhost refers to the application container itself

Resolve the hostname host.docker.internal → 172.17.0.1
Connect to the specified port 172.17.0.1:5432
docker needs to know which IP address should represent the host machine inside a container (via host-gateway)
